scientific_integrity: The exact unrestricted result is established by an analytical binary-cut and geometric-carry proof. Exact rational finite experiments corroborate but do not replace the proof. Historical novelty remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a single left-to-right unweighted adjacent mean-averaging sweep on real path signals and complete-pair Gini variation. Does not treat arbitrary edge orders, weighted Gini variation, repeated-sweep optimal rates, or all norming vectors. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Exact Gini contraction of a left-to-right path gossip sweep
